time_unit: ms of game time (Match-V5 timeline timestamp)
patch_mapping: Match-V5 gameVersion 15.N = public patch 25.N; 16.N = 26.N. patch_range bounds are Match-V5 major.minor, inclusive.

status_legend.verified: documented in a Riot patch note or the official LoL wiki AND consistent with 15.14 events (500-match scan, stage1/objective_timers/validation)
status_legend.documented: documented (patch note / wiki) but no data check was possible under the split rules (16.x events are not read)
status_legend.uncertain: sources conflict or no source found; the value is a best reading and gameplay.objective_timers exposes a flag for it

sources.wiki_dragon: https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Elemental_drake (first spawn 5:00, respawn 5:00, Rift transforms after the 2nd drake, soul at a team's 4th drake, Elder 6:00 after the 4th drake, Elder respawn 6:00)
sources.wiki_aspect: https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aspect_of_the_Dragon (150 s, living members of the slayer's team, lost upon death)
sources.wiki_hand_of_baron: https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Hand_of_Baron (180 s, living champions, lost upon death)
sources.wiki_herald: https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rift_Herald (V25.S1.1 spawn 16:00, despawn 24:45 / 24:55 in combat; V25.09 spawn 15:00; infobox (2026) says despawn 19:45 / 19:55 without a patch entry)
sources.wiki_voidgrub_camp: https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Voidgrub_camp (V25.09 spawn 8:00, no respawn; despawn 14:45 / 14:55 in combat; V26.01 stat changes only)
sources.wiki_atakhan: https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Atakhan (spawn 20:00, one per game; V26.01 removed from the game)
sources.wiki_turret: https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Turret (Nexus turrets respawn 3 minutes after being destroyed)
sources.patch_26_1: https://www.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/game-updates/patch-26-1-notes/ (Baron 25m -> 20m; Atakhan removed; outer turret plates permanent instead of falling at 14 minutes; minions 1:05 -> 0:30; no Dragon / Herald / Voidgrub spawn-time change listed)
